tasks.short: Negotiate clients' contractual rights and obligations.

steps.what: Locate the client's current contract, amendments and relevant negotiation correspondence
Assess the actual rights, obligations, disputed points and client's negotiating mandate
Negotiate nonbinding proposals with managers, promoters, union officials or other parties within the client's mandate
outputs: actual negotiated proposals, open points and reservations

steps.what: Write and check the actual negotiation note, proposed terms, reservations and next decision without recording a proposal as an executed amendment
inputs: actual negotiated proposals, open points and reservations
outputs: checked final negotiation note and exact client-contract target

steps.what: Save the checked negotiation note in the restricted client contract record
inputs: checked final negotiation note and exact client-contract target

tasks.design: Configure contract-linked references in the {CLM} so the agent retrieves the actual executed version and amendments together. Keep interpretation, bargaining and actual negotiation-note writing human; no software accepts terms or executes an amendment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Contract revisions and correspondence can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native contract identifiers and linked document views can reduce retrieval effort.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing rights, commercial relationships and the client's priorities.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing what to concede, challenge or reserve for client decision.

ambition.what: No additional negotiation authority is created.

tasks.altitude: Less retrieval; the agent keeps the same mandate.

reach.task: Prepare an evidence-linked contract issue list
reach.learn: Distinguish an executed term from a negotiating proposal.

evidence.claim: Native contract-linked views can reduce document retrieval without performing bargaining or legal interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary is negotiation and its actual internal note. Client advice sends, binding acceptance and signature are separate final-version actions and are not hidden in the conversation or credited here.

Contract owners supply client ID, contract ID, executed revision, amendment dates and access links. The client supplies the actual mandate. Missing or conflicting versions are manually checked; a draft is not treated as operative.
Test native {CLM} links first. No model extracts contractual meaning or drafts concessions. The 35% retrieval reduction affects only finding existing sources.
The ordinary author check in s4 binds a1 to the finished note, proposed-status labels and exact client-contract destination. Later edits require rechecking; saving remains full effort.
unknowns: Current revision links and repeated retrieval time.
research_questions: Can the native contract view distinguish executed documents from open proposals reliably?

already_counted.description: Write and check actual negotiation findings.

approvals.approved_version: Final actual negotiation note, proposal-status labels and exact client-contract destination checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only retrieval falls from 15 to 9.75 points; 5.25 gross less 0.75 upkeep. Low is no deployment if versions are already consolidated.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop contacts and apply strategies for clients' success.

steps.what: Look up existing contacts, actual past dealings and the client's stated priorities
Develop personal contacts with relevant individuals and organizations through actual conversations and meetings
Choose and personally apply relationship strategies suited to the client's aims and the actual opportunity
outputs: actual applied relationship strategy and results

steps.what: Write and check minimal actual contact developments, permissions and follow-up commitments
inputs: actual applied relationship strategy and results
outputs: checked final contact update and exact relationship record

steps.what: Save the checked actual contact developments to the authorized relationship record
inputs: checked final contact update and exact relationship record

tasks.design: Configure a client-specific relationship view in the {CRM} using actual contact history. Keep relationship building, strategy and actual contact-note writing personal; no automated outreach or invented introduction is included.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing relationship context can require opening several contact records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native client-contact views can display authorized past dealings together.
tasks.still_hard: Building trust and judging whether an introduction helps the client.

ambition.what: No additional contact volume is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less context navigation; relationship ownership stays personal.

reach.task: Keep an accurate client relationship history
reach.learn: Record actual permission and avoid treating a possible lead as a commitment.

evidence.claim: Native relationship views can reduce navigation but do not create trust or perform introductions.

assumptions: Boundary is relationship development and its existing minimal contact note. Promotion campaigns, engagement bookings and separate messages are not duplicated here.

The agent supplies contact ID, organization, date, actual dealing, permission limits and next commitment after real interactions. Missing history is confirmed manually; no model invents a relationship from a public profile.
Test native {CRM} views first. Contact authoring and checking receive no reduction; there is no model or inferred relationship score.
a1 binds the final actual contact update and exact relationship record checked during writing in s4. Changed content requires rechecking; the ordinary save remains fully counted.
unknowns: Whether the current client view already provides relationship context.
research_questions: Does a native client-contact view remove repeated context lookup?

already_counted.description: Write and check actual contact developments.

incremental.description: Maintain client-contact links and permission fields.

approvals.approved_version: Final minimal actual contact update, permission limits and exact relationship record checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Context lookup saves 4 points, less 0.5 upkeep. Actual relationships, strategy, note authoring and save retain full effort; already linked records give no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule clients' promotional or performance engagements.

steps.what: Confirm requirements to schedule promotional or performance engagements for clients, including agreed terms, client constraints and existing scheduling authority
Check actual client and organizer availability, locations and travel buffers
Compare feasible engagement slots and identify clashes and travel-buffer conflicts
Choose the engagement slot with the client and organizer and resolve actual exceptions within existing authority
Prepare and check the complete calendar entry and confirmation message, location, time zone, agreed terms and exact recipients
outputs: checked final engagement entry and exact confirmation package

steps.what: Commit the checked exact engagement entry to the client's calendar
inputs: checked final engagement entry and exact confirmation package

steps.what: Send only the checked exact engagement confirmation to the agreed client and organizer recipients
inputs: checked final engagement entry and exact confirmation package

tasks.design: Use native {CALENDAR} availability and conflict rules, with manually confirmed organizer availability where access is absent. Reuse the actual agreed scheduling choice in entry and confirmation fields, retaining human exception resolution and separate gates for calendar commitment and external confirmation.
tasks.previous_blocker: External availability and travel constraints can be copied between calendars and mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Native shared-calendar views, time zones and templates can remove repeated mechanics.
tasks.still_hard: Reconciling commitments, travel and client preferences.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding which opportunity and scheduling compromise serves the client.

ambition.what: No extra bookings or authority to accept contractual terms is assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less slot comparison and copying, unchanged scheduling delegation.

reach.task: Maintain a feasible client engagement calendar
reach.learn: Distinguish scheduling confirmation from contractual acceptance.

evidence.claim: Native shared availability, conflict checks and reusable event fields can reduce scheduling mechanics.

assumptions: Boundary is scheduling an already agreed engagement, not negotiating or accepting its contract. Client and organizer labour is outside the focal denominator and receives no saving. Client-issue meetings under 12873 are separate appointments.

The client and organizer produce actual availability, time zone, location and agreed duration. The agent supplies engagement ID, buffers, confirmed terms and exact recipients. Missing calendar access requires manual confirmation; absence of a busy mark is not consent.
Try native shared views, conflict rules and event templates first. No model or autonomous booking is required.

The normal final author check in s5 binds a1 to the complete entry and a2 to the exact confirmation text and recipients. Edits or changed availability require rechecking. Both actions remain 1% fully retained.
unknowns: Calendar sharing permissions and current template use.
research_questions: Do native calendars capture travel buffers and organizer constraints without extra data copying?

already_counted.description: Check candidate slots and assemble and verify the final entry and confirmation.

incremental.description: Maintain calendar access and engagement-field templates.

approvals.approved_version: Final exact engagement, client calendar, time zone, location and duration checked in s5
Final exact engagement confirmation text, agreed terms and client and organizer recipients checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Availability lookup saves 11.25 points, comparisons 6 and reused entry fields 3.9; gross 21.15 less 1.5 upkeep. No deployment if native features already cover this work or external availability stays manual.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Arrange meetings concerning issues involving clients by clarifying the actual issue, purpose, necessary participants and disclosure limits
Collect actual participant availability and meeting location or call requirements
Agree a suitable meeting option and resolve participant or confidentiality exceptions
Prepare and check the final issue-meeting invitation with time, location or call link, minimal agenda and exact attendees
outputs: checked final issue-meeting invitation and attendee list

steps.what: Send the checked exact issue-meeting invitation and create its calendar event through the native invitation action
inputs: checked final issue-meeting invitation and attendee list
outputs: actual dispatched invitation and calendar event

tasks.design: Configure native availability views and reusable invitation fields in {CALENDAR}. Keep purpose, confidentiality decisions, actual participant agreement and final invitation checking human; the native send creates the meeting event as the same action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Availability collection and repeated invitation fields can consume arrangement time.
tasks.enabler_now: Shared availability and native invitation templates can avoid repeated mechanics.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing who needs to attend and what can be disclosed.
tasks.human_edge: Understanding the client issue and negotiating an appropriate meeting.

ambition.what: No extra client meetings are assumed.

tasks.altitude: Less arrangement work; no change to client representation authority.

reach.learn: Minimize invitation details and verify recipients.

evidence.claim: Native calendars can reuse meeting fields and show authorized availability.

assumptions: This task arranges issue meetings only. It does not conduct them or duplicate promotional and performance engagements under 12868. Attendees' time receives no saving.

The agent produces actual purpose, minimal agenda, duration and attendee identity; participants supply availability and access needs. Missing availability is collected manually, not inferred from silence.

Try native availability and invitation facilities first. The 34% invitation share includes existing entry and ordinary final checking, not a new approval or report requirement. If invitation fields are already reused, there is no new saving.

a1 binds the completed invitation text, time, call or location, access settings and exact attendees checked in s4. Any edit voids it. Native send and event creation are one atomic action here; if the system separates them, model separate gated actions.
unknowns: Actual time spent on existing invitation assembly and current template use.
research_questions: Can native invitation fields reduce arrangement effort without exposing the client's issue details?

already_counted.description: Prepare and check the final invitation.

incremental.description: Maintain invitation templates and shared-availability access.

approvals.approved_version: Exact final issue-meeting invitation text, time, location or call link, access and attendee list checked in s4

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Availability collection saves 15 points and invitation mechanics 17; gross 32 less 1 upkeep. No adoption if sharing is unavailable or templates already remove this work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: Maintain evidence-linked client contract and scheduling records with the business manager.
skills_to_grow: Check exact recipients and time zones
